name: Hajimari no Kisetsu ~Izakaya Fuyu Monogatari~
original_name: はじまりの季節 ～居酒屋冬物語～
source: The protagonist's relationship with his girlfriend is not doing very well. She's even being courted by his boss! In an effort to rekindle their love, he takes her on a vacation to a ski resort. But will that be enough to win back her heart?
translation: 主人公与女友的关系并不顺利，她甚至受到他上司的追求！为了重燃爱火，他带她去滑雪胜地度假。但这足以挽回她的心吗？
